functional_requirements: Customer furniture configuration wizard (dimensions, materials, colors)
Secure credit card payment processing checkout
Customer account creation and order history tracking
Admin trigger email notifications to customers
non_functional_requirements: Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop
High Security (PCI standards compliance for payments)
Scalability (smooth handling of traffic spikes, particularly during holiday sales)
risks: Integration challenges if future FedEx/UPS API integration is complex
Performance issues if 3D previews impact the sub-2 second load time goal
assumptions: All users placing orders will be required to create an account
Admins will have a completely separate portal (possibly on a different subdomain)
Shipping will initially use a flat-rate calculation
questions: What are the specific dimensions, materials, and colors that need to be configurable for the furniture?
Are there any specific payment gateway providers preferred for credit card processing?
Should the email notifications be fully customizable by the admins, or just triggered from templates?
Will the 3D previews be pre-rendered models or dynamically generated?
What constitutes a 'traffic spike' in terms of concurrent users or transactions per minute?
